_about: Benchmark tasks on a copy of examples/usb-sensor-test. 'prep' changes the copy before the run (prep.py), 'check' verifies the result (check.py). Prompts say what to do, never how.

tasks.prompt: Rotate the four mounting holes H1, H2, H3 and H4 to 45 degrees, each in place (do not move them). Save the board. KiCad is not running; work on the files in this folder.

Add a net class named I2C with track width 0.25 mm and clearance 0.2 mm, and assign the nets /I2C_SCL and /I2C_SDA to it, so that KiCad's DRC uses it. KiCad is not running; work on the files in this folder.

Five nets on the board have no tracks: /LED_STATUS, /LED_STATUS_A, /LED_PWR_A, /CC1 and /CC2. Route them on the board at their net class width, with no new DRC errors. Save the board. KiCad is not running; work on the files in this folder.

C3 is a 100 nF decoupling capacitor that has been moved off the board and its tracks removed. Place it on the front, with its centre within 3 mm of the U1 pad on the same supply net as C3 pin 1, without overlapping other parts, and route it. No new DRC errors. Save the board. KiCad is not running; work on the files in this folder.
The board has new DRC errors. Run DRC, find what causes them and fix it, changing nothing else. Save the board. KiCad is not running; work on the files in this folder.
